steps.note: Enable the configured purchase-request audit trail for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions list as the buyer.

args.goal: select a PR from the Open purchase requisitions list by clicking its PR number, then stop on the PR detail page showing every line's type, Requested/Open/In Progress/Ordered quantities, unit and plant, plus the PR header with requester, dates and status

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated PR-number detail navigation or assertion step, so inspect the requested detail page directly in the buyer session.
Confirm the opened PR detail page has no loading failure, raw identifiers, or application error.
